rationale: DOX has gapped down ~31% on fundamental deterioration (T-Mobile legal dispute, projected 7-11% revenue decline in FY2027), creating an extremely wide spread (37.7 bps) and highly erratic price action with a massive volume spike (16.5x relative volume) that signals ongoing institutional distribution rather than a clean technical setup. The stock is sitting near the upper portion of today's range (74.7%) with price just below the 9-EMA ($45.22), offering no clear directional edge — a long risks continuation of the fundamental selloff while a short risks a dead-cat-bounce squeeze given the already extreme gap. The risk/reward is too uncertain to justify adding exposure alongside existing committed positions.
